title: Semantic Advisory Finding
description: One surfaced advisory finding emitted by the severed semantic-validation lane (ADR-043 Decision 2, ADR-044, ADR-045, FR-68). Advisory only: never a ValidationError, never an edit to a spec file. snake_case at the wire boundary. The eligibility-visibility fields (FR-68 AC6, ADR-053/FR-84) are required: the lane stamps escalation_eligible and effective_confidence_threshold on every finding, identically in strict and non-strict runs.

rule_gate_disclosure.description: FR-68 AC9 OPTIONAL payload-level disclosure — NOT part of the per-finding object above. The findings artifact MAY carry a top-level `rule_gates` map keyed by registered rule_id; each value gives that entry's OWN precision-gate status and whether it participated as active or inert. Emitted only by the lane path (sdd.semantic.serialization.findings_payload) and identically in strict and non-strict runs; it is NEVER an input to the FR-84 strict exit-code projection. Emission is enforced in serialization; this $def documents the wire shape. `additionalProperties` here validates each per-rule entry.
